LESSON: SELECTED CHAPTERS 90:1

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulumul Qur’an (8 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learner s
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapters 90:1

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Chapters 90:1. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al-Balad (Q. :1-) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al- Balad (Q. :1-) for better understanding

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al-Balad (Q. :1-) correctly for spiritual nourishment
   In simple words: practise until you can read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al-Balad (Q. :1-) correctly for spiritual nourishment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al- Balad (Q. :1-) for better understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al- Balad (Q. :1-) for better understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Chapters 90:1 using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Chapters 90:1 in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Chapters 90:1 to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Chapters 90:1.
4. Show that you can: read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al-Balad (Q. :1-) correctly for spiritual nourishment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Chapters 90:1 using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Chapters 90:1 important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the meaning of the selected surah and make class presentations,
2. Digital Literacy: the learner interacts with digital technology when researching online the teachings/lessons from the selected surah
3. Citizenship: social and civic skills as learners dramatise teachings/lessons from the selected surah (treatment of orphans, respect for parents and humility)
4. Learning to Learn: the learners develop relationships as they share learnt knowledge during class presentations on teachings/lessons from the selected surah. Values:
5. Social Justice: the learners cooperate during dramatization on the teachings/lessons from the selected surah (treatment of orphans.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?
2. How can a Muslim apply the teachings of the selected surah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al-Balad (Q. :1-) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.:1-) and surah Al- Balad (Q. :1-) for better understanding

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
